description: Machine-readable index of the dashboard prototyping resources. Read by the dataesr-mcp /tableaux server from GitHub; keep it in sync with README.md.

guidance.title: Prototyping conventions, data sources, common vs dedicated code, manifest

templates.title: Client board skeleton
templates.description: Routes, layouts and pages of a board. A reference to adapt, not a generator.

templates.title: Server router stub
templates.description: Minimal board router, a route and an .http request file. Add routes serving fixtures from a fixtures/ folder in a new board.

templates.title: Board manifest JSON Schema
templates.description: Schema of board.manifest.json; the README documents the fields and an example.

data_sources.name: Board JSON fixtures
data_sources.purpose: Synthetic or public sample data served by the board's routes.
data_sources.guide: Keep representative fixture JSON in server/src/routes/boards/<board-id>/fixtures/. No production records, credentials or confidential data. Isolate the read in one place so an approved data access can replace it without changing the route path or response shape.

data_sources.name: Tableaux MongoDB
data_sources.guide: Use fixtures unless the data owner approves the exact collections and read-only access. Read it from the board's server routes only, never from the browser.

data_sources.name: Elasticsearch (via the /elasticsearch proxy)
data_sources.purpose: Configured Elasticsearch indexes behind ES_TOKEN_* credentials.
data_sources.guide: Use fixtures unless the data owner approves a specific index, read-only access and data classification. Several existing boards call the proxy from the browser; do not copy that pattern, read it from the board's server routes.

data_sources.name: Paysage API
data_sources.purpose: PAYSAGE_API_URL / PAYSAGE_API_KEY, used by the board.
data_sources.guide: Use fixtures unless approved. Keep calls in the board.

data_sources.name: Opendatasoft API
data_sources.guide: Use fixtures unless the data owner approves the dataset and access.
